notes.title: Big sales success and new patch with improvements!
notes.content:
Hello to all of you! First of all thank you for the huge support you are giving to the game. We want to thank you by adding content with a series of patches that will be arriving during these months. We will be adding new girls, new sex scenes, new games of chance and much more. In today's patch we have extended the length of the sex scenes and made some adjustments to improve the experience:

-The length of the sex scenes has been extended.

-The rate at which prostitutes increase their fatigue bar has been lowered.

-Fixed a bug that allowed the police to see you through the wall.

Thank you all very much and we'll have more content ready for you to enjoy soon!
